lesson.title: 911 – Procedure 500: Abbreviations and Jargon (Part 1: 2X2 through Correction)
objectives: Identify and define core abbreviations and jargon from Procedure 500 (2X2 through Correction).
Select the correct abbreviation or jargon when given its meaning.
Recall exact wordings so you avoid inventing non-standard abbreviations.
